s2_basis.note: 320/320 matched KC have static 2-hop paths; dynamic effective drive is unresolved.

target.rule: S1R matched-320 KC set; frozen before S3

injection_semantics.api: FlyBrain.step(inject=[(indices, amount)]) adds amount to v directly; amount is a voltage increment, not nA
injection_semantics.lif: v <- exp(-dt/tau) v + gain*W@spikes + tonic + noise + inject; v>=1 -> spike; reset 0

design.network: official MaleCNS synthetic B KC->KC-zero; original LIF/noise/weight semantics

kc_intervention.saturation_guard: primary mean KC firing <0.85 and fraction of matched KCs with per-cell primary mean >=0.95 <=0.10
kc_intervention.pass_rule: effect>=+0.10 AND p<0.05 AND CI low>0 AND not saturated

mbon_downstream.conditional: interpreted only if KC intervention passes
mbon_downstream.pass_rule: effect>=+0.05 AND p<0.05 AND CI low>0

primary_endpoints.negative: MBON effect<=-0.05 with p<0.05 and CI high<0 is reported as KC_MBON_NEGATIVE, not a positive functional pass

secondary_analysis.low_dose: kc_low-sham for KC and MBON; descriptive; BH across the two low-dose endpoints; cannot replace primary
secondary_analysis.all_cell_level: descriptive only; no cell-level p-value selection

decision_tree.if: KC effect<+0.10 or p>=0.05 or CI includes 0

decision_tree.downstream_interpretation: downstream KC->MBON functional under artificial drive; natural sensory limitation remains supported, not proven

decision_tree.if: KC passes and MBON effect>=+0.05 but p>=0.05/CI includes 0
decision_tree.downstream_interpretation: cannot distinguish weak downstream from no downstream

decision_tree.if: KC passes and MBON effect<=-0.05 with p<0.05/CI high<0
decision_tree.downstream_interpretation: inhibitory/negative downstream response; not a positive chain

decision_tree.if: KC passes and MBON neither positive nor negative significant
decision_tree.downstream_interpretation: downstream not activated under artificial KC drive; artificial limitation

risk_matrix.mitigation: predeclared low/primary; KC success gate; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
predeclared mean<0.85 and >=0.95 fraction<=0.10 gate; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
sham, paired seeds, both doses, explicit no-natural/learning claim
sham and predeclared target set; artificial conclusion only
900 s/2048 MiB, one shot, no retry/no cap increase
hierarchical KC gate; low-dose BH; no cell-level selection

resource.note: Linear time scaling from S1R; extra condition is not concurrent, peak estimate is approximate. Must be treated as unverified; no automatic increase.

authorization.note: This is a preregistration only; no S3 authorization or lock is created.

answers.q1_target_and_current_freeze: Use the S1R matched-320 KC global indices (SHA-256 frozen) and predeclare primary DV_inf=0.20 (amount 0.0362538494) with low DV_inf=0.10 (amount 0.0181269247); no pilot dose selection.
answers.q2_discriminating_result: Only KC intervention success followed by MBON positive/negative/absent outcome can discriminate upstream effective drive from downstream KC->MBON function; KC failure is INCONCLUSIVE.
answers.q3_avoid_false_functional_claim: Sham, paired seeds, two doses, KC success gate, saturation gate, and explicit artificial-synchronous-drive limitation; no natural pathway or learning claim.
answers.q4_worth_one_run: YES, conditional on resource preflight: estimated 413.4 s and ~1948 MiB, tight but within caps; unverified, no retry/no increase.
answers.q5_inconclusive: KC not driven, KC saturated, ambiguous MBON CI, missing seeds, resource/timeout, or any failure to meet predeclared gates.
answers.next_experiment_candidate: Direct KC current injection (sham/low/primary) with matched-320 targets, new seeds 201-225; do not execute without a new S3 authorization.
